checkpoint_response.rule: Persist this exact metadata-only committed response. Never reconstruct replay from current ui_working_copies. Do not include payload, draft, dirty paths, key field values or base revision token. Full draft is available only through recovery queries while the row exists.

confirmation_refinement.binding: exact current eligible LLD-03 eligibility_fingerprint and target revision; single-use LLD-12 proof

task_detail_transport_reconciliation.rule: Reconcile the complete LLD-05 TaskWorkbench transport leaf, retain semantically explicit existing field names, and consume that single DTO. No LLD-10 composition DTO or private-table joins. Keep HTTP binding pending until the owning transport leaf is reconciled.

inventory_transport_reconciliation.list_response: SpareRequestPageV1.items becomes SpareRequestListItemV1; preserve requester creation evidence, SR context, owner as_of age and action blockers
inventory_transport_reconciliation.detail_response: GET /api/v1/inventory/requests/{request_id} becomes SpareRequestDetailV1; richer owner detail, no core DTO enlargement
inventory_transport_reconciliation.needs_response: Close SpareNeedProjectionV1 and implement owner InventoryNeedsQuery; no UI-local DTO or Inventory private-table access from LLD10
inventory_transport_reconciliation.implemented: Inventory-owned Need facts and non-Customer filters with bounded filter-bound keyset pagination, one read snapshot and indexed page-restricted aggregate summaries; not yet the complete HTTP contract

customer_context.membership_owner: LLD03 general read-only Service Request reference provider; immutable SR identity/revision and explicit current Customer relationship metadata/unresolved/unassigned state
customer_context.scope_owner: LLD02 CustomerScopeProvider for all/specific/unassigned and Customer display identity
customer_context.consumer: LLD07-local InventoryReferenceReader anti-corruption adapter; do not reuse import-specific ServiceRequestImportReader or join LLD03 private tables
customer_context.batch_rule: Add bounded set-based owner read for list pages up to 500; no N+1 point-read pattern
customer_context.filter_rule: specific matches current SR Customer relationship, unassigned its absence, all applies no Customer predicate; never infer from requester/receiver/Contact affiliation

communications_chronology_refinement.rule: Canonical UTC whole-second application/message chronology. types/common.json utc_epoch_ms is stale. Consume the existing owner DTO unchanged; do not change ProviderCheckpointV1.provider_time_source_epoch_ms or convert owner timestamps.
invariants: known=false requires null instant and UNKNOWN source
known=true requires whole-second instant and supported provider chronology source; scan/discovery/current time cannot substitute

grouping_list_transport_reconciliation.rule: Dedicated live list item with complete filters/cursor and exact batched warnings. Separate immutable GroupingRecomputeProposalV1/GroupingRecomputeProposalPageV1 for recompute; no live classifications in command replay. Compact accept/reject/reconsider DTO unchanged.
